label.en: Proceeds from disposal of non-current assets (+)

currentTwLabel: 處分不動產、廠房及設備
ifrsEnglish: Proceeds from disposal of non-current assets

note.zh-TW: 網站補充的延伸列，課程模板沒有；金額不為零時才顯示，並標「模板無此列」。
note.en: An extension line added by the site; the course template has no such line. It is shown only when the amount is non-zero, marked as not in the template.

definition.zh-TW:
賣掉機器設備等長期資產時收到的現金。

這是投資活動的流入；賣價和帳面金額的差額（處分損益）列在損益表的營業外收支，不影響這一列的金額。
definition.en:
Cash received from selling long-lived assets such as machinery.

It is an investing inflow; the difference between the selling price and the carrying amount (the gain or loss on disposal) goes to non-operating income or expenses on the income statement and does not change this line.

example.zh-TW: 位置：現金流量表投資活動區。本課故事沒有處分資產，所以用不到。
example.en: Where it sits: the investing activities section of the statement of cash flows. The course story disposes of nothing, so it is not used.

misconception.zh-TW: 把處分利益當成這一列的金額。這一列填的是收到的全部價款，不是賺到的差額；處分利益另外在損益表出現，間接法裡還要從稅前淨利扣掉以免重複。
misconception.en: Entering the gain on disposal as this line’s amount. The line records the full proceeds received, not the profit made; the gain appears separately on the income statement and is deducted from profit before tax in the indirect method to avoid double counting.
